name: Obsidian vault
author: Enplace
summary: Keep a project's work as Markdown notes in your Obsidian vault.
description: Each work item is a note in your vault, in an Enplace folder with one folder per project, and the two stay in step both ways while Obsidian is open. The note's properties hold its stage, priority, tags and due date, and its first heading is the title. Change the stage in Obsidian and the work moves; edit the work here and the note is rewritten, keeping any properties of your own. A new note in the folder becomes work (through Approvals) and gets its key written in. Deleting a note marks the work done; nothing is ever deleted. It works through the Enplace plugin for Obsidian, which you connect with this project's address and secret, so it syncs on any device that runs Obsidian.

webhook.about: The Enplace plugin for Obsidian sends your notes here and writes back what changed, every few seconds while Obsidian is open.
steps: In Obsidian: Settings › Community plugins, install Enplace and switch it on.
In its settings, press Connect a project and paste both.
Your notes appear in Enplace/<project>/Work in the vault.

settings.name: Write all work as notes
settings.help: Every open work item in the project gets a note, the ones there before you connected too. Off: only new notes from the vault come in.
